response.sql:
WITH profile_averages AS (
  SELECT o."weathprofile", AVG(t."bandusagepct") AS avg_bandusagepct, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM "telescopes" AS t
  JOIN "observatories" AS o ON o."observstation" = t."observstation"
  WHERE t."detecttempk" > 152.1
  GROUP BY o."weathprofile"
), with_mean AS (
  SELECT *, AVG(avg_bandusagepct) OVER () AS mean_profile_average
  FROM profile_averages
)
SELECT "weathprofile", avg_bandusagepct, telescope_count,
       avg_bandusagepct - mean_profile_average AS difference_from_mean
FROM with_mean
WHERE mean_profile_average IS NOT NULL;

assumptions.assumption: “High side” means strictly greater than 152.1. Telescope count includes qualifying telescopes even when their bandwidth usage is missing; AVG ignores missing bandwidth values.
